segments.moves:
blessed gold dragon scales
Wl #polyself
gold dragon
    #polyself
human

comment: polyself.c skinback() returns merged dragon scales to body armor and, when they give off light, calls obj.c maybe_adjust_light() for the change from the embedded radius 1 to the worn radius ('Your set of gold dragon scales shines much brighter.'). A human Healer in debug mode (no body armor to remove, fixed letters so the wish lands on l) wishes for blessed gold dragon scales, wears them (they light), polymorphs into a gold dragon to merge with them, then polymorphs into a human, which runs newman() and polyman(). The seed and date were chosen arbitrarily, avoiding a full or new moon message.
